classification_policy.unit: One model-declared Workflow.unresolved record; composite records receive one dominant primary reason, so the eight category counts sum to 66. These are descriptive classifications, not error/recall rates.

definitions.unregistered_dependency_or_original_arti: Model names a cited protocol, implementation, attachment or source artifact absent from its registered context; not a claim that it is unavailable on the public web.
definitions.delegated_kit_reagent_or_device_internal: Named vendor/kit/buffer/device boundary is known but its detailed implementation is delegated.
definitions.unreported_recipe_or_quantity: Reported boundary with unspecified allocation, concentration, timing, handling or reaction detail.
definitions.oligo_index_or_decoder_identity: Exact sequence/dictionary, selected identity, read parsing or sample/index assignment remains unassigned.
definitions.source_wording_unit_or_variant_conflict: Reported wording/units/alias or variant descriptions are ambiguous, differently scoped or in tension.
definitions.analysis_parameters_or_numeric_reproduct: Rules, releases, coordinate sets, sample associations, fitting settings or numerical inputs needed for exact calculation remain unassigned.
definitions.specimen_or_optional_variant_scope: No universal transfer/preparation/performance is established beyond the demonstrated specimen or selected branch.
definitions.rendition_loss: The model attributes missing equations/symbols or image-only details to its text rendition; this does not mean the original paper omits them.

assessment.finding: No general-assay architecture blocker was independently established in the six selected high-risk checks. This is not an endorsement that all 66 are true gaps, correctly scoped, exhaustive, or harmless under a stronger claim.
assessment.criterion: A declared unknown is potentially architecture-blocking if it leaves a necessary material/identity/readout handoff unintelligible or the record asserts the missing fact as known. Missing internal recipes, unchosen historical samples, or numeric reproduction settings alone do not prove that a qualified named input/output boundary is absent.
assessment.preserve: Fixation, digestion/recovery, barcode/marker association and estimator dependencies must remain explicit qualified boundaries; do not replace unknown internals with another method’s recipe or infer chemistry from a shared name.
assessment.separate_existing_finding: The earlier ATAC categorical nonreturn/positive-review concern is an asserted-fact grounding issue outside these 66 declared unresolved records. Nonblocking-gap counts do not certify the remaining record clauses.

record_classifications.reported_description_start: The primary reports dish harvest into QIAzol and RNA entering biotinylation, but does not explicitly assign its miRNeasy statement (scoped to qRT-PCR) to production RNA cleanup
Fuchs shows a drug-removal wash but does not specify its buffer, count or handling of 4sU during the release interface
Fuchs delegates TruSeq RNA v2 without poly(A) isolation, with random-hexamer RT, but does not report enriched-RNA mass/volume or exact entry into the guide fragmentation stage

The supplied guide provides indexed adapter choices and sample-record requirements, while Fuchs reports pooled sequencing and per-sample analysis without the selected index-to-sample map, complete adapter/primer oligos, index-read cycle settings or demultiplexing implementation

The supplied guide recommends qPCR library quantification and yield-based normalization, but the separate part #11322363 protocol is unavailable and the primary does not independently document its execution or actual pooling/loading ratios

The paper supplies boundary-search and rate-filter rules, pseudocounts, peak-finder name and modified-Thompson-tau attribution, but not a complete numerical implementation of spline/background histogram choices, outlier parameters or 50% slope-confidence calculation

The primary paper reports Illumina transposase, 2x TD buffer, adapter-loaded hyperactive Tn5 and adapter integration, but does not provide the internal commercial buffer/enzyme formulation, exact loaded duplex oligos or complete strand/end structure
The 500/5,000-cell section specifies a 5 μL transposition reaction and direct transfer into 50 μL PCR, while inheriting the common protocol

The source provides five initial cycles, removal of an aliquot, addition of 10 μL cocktail at 0.6x SYBR, 20 analytical cycles and remaining 45 μL production reaction, with the aim of stopping before saturation and reported 10–12 production cycles
Supplementary Table 1 gives Ad1_noMX and 24 indexed Ad2 PCR oligos; the Methods specifies custom Nextera primers 1 and 2
qPCR-based final-library quantitation is reported with a long-fragment rationale, but no quantitation kit, standards, dilution series or loading calculation is given
The packet provides hg19, BOWTIE -X2000/-m1, Picard duplicate removal, ZINBA window/offset/posterior rule, Danpos/Dantools parameters and CENTIPEDE features
The Methods specifies size bins, splitting dinucleosome reads into two and trinucleosome reads into three, and short-read negative background

The optional chromatin-class fingerprint analysis names the Ensembl regulatory segmentation source and the state-wise/genome-wide normalization rule, but does not fix the exact annotation release/file
The ADT subsection blocks before staining, while the transcriptomic subsection describes a 30 min BSA/inhibitor block
The overview and Table S2 identify the complementary linker and its ligation role, but p00043 does not assign its concentration or addition volume to the detailed mix
The bead protocol delegates B&W buffer to the manufacturer manual, and SU-8 processing to MicroChem recommendations
The first-PCR wording gives 8.8 μL of 10 μM stocks of primers 1 and 2 without specifying whether 8.8 μL is per primer or combined
Nextera XT construction and tagmentation of the RNA branch are reported, but internal library reaction settings and selected RNA adapter/index identity are not supplied
The reported ADT:RNA pool ratio is 1:9, but its molar/mass/volume basis is unspecified
Primary p00050 says mouse genome (GRCh38); the pinned author README names GRCm38_86 and gencode.vM11
The documented reformat.pl requires an 8-base-code first-column lookup with an index in column two; the actual hard-coded 00.database/barcode.xls is absent
Primary overview describes spatial tags at one paired-read end and target/protein tags at the other, while p00051 assigns antibody-derived and spatial tag extraction to Read 2
The primary paper delegates trimming, alignment, demultiplexing, annotation and matrix generation to ST pipeline v1.7.2
The source permits channel imaging and morphology correlation, and the author README gives a manual RNA image-alignment example
Ad-2 is described as a defined 27-nt 5′ sequence followed by eight random nucleotides (main p00005), while supplement p00021/p00149 specify GGG or TTT at its 3′ end
The primary source specifies P1 sequence and a one-cycle temperature program for second-strand synthesis but not the full polymerase/buffer composition at that modified DR-seq step
DR-seq explicitly recovers unfragmented aRNA and delegates library preparation to CEL-Seq
The cited CEL-Seq protocol names RA3, RTP, RP1 and selected RPIX but does not provide their full sequences in the inspected library passages

The primary Methods report on-bead digestion of biotinylated DNA, two bead washes and their combination with the first supernatant, but do not identify the digestion reagent, reaction conditions or exact released molecular species
The primary passage labels a buffer 2× BW and lists 10 mM Tris-HCl, 1 mM EDTA and 2 mM NaCl
The delegated CEL-Seq RNeasy cleanup text states 500 mL 80% EtOH in a column-wash step

DR-seq reports NEBNext Ultra genomic libraries with a distinct cell index but not exact index sequences, input amount after adapter depletion, end-preparation/ligation/PCR settings or size-selection settings
Main p00010/p00025 and Supplementary Note section 3 explain the coverage-based estimator’s purpose and placement but do not give a fully specified computation in the inspected text
DR-seq cites Zhang et al

The optional supplemental coding-SNV route names GATK HaplotypeCaller and VariantFiltration, but not software version or filter expressions

STAR version, reference genomes and unique-mapping restriction are reported, and the source declares gene-of-origin assignment

The independent corroboration is supported at the RNeasy Plus and RT-ddPCR input/output/readout boundaries, with the exact stated panel, cell-equivalent basis and repeat design

The packet establishes the native mESC-to-readout architecture and key reaction conditions, but the primary Methods delegate further SLAM-seq detail to Protocol Exchange 2017 (doi:10.1038/protex.2017.105), extraction to TRIzol instructions and library construction to Quant-seq manufacturer instructions
Quant-seq linker/primer sequences, the selectable external-index sequence list and adapter-clipping sequence are not identified in the relevant packet descriptions

The source describes its extended 3′ annotation and counting-window generation rules and says BED files are provided with datasets; the packet text does not supply the BED coordinates or a full inspected UTRannotation implementation

No-s4U background subtraction and SNP exclusion are explicit, but the relevant Methods do not specify exact matching/pooling of background datasets to samples/time points or whether SNP calls were per sample or pooled
The packet names the RT, barcode/linker/blocking, template-switch and PCR/index oligos but does not contain their complete nucleotide sequences/modifications or the well-barcode/index dictionary

The primary explicitly supports formaldehyde-fixed nuclei as assay input, and the supplement supplies a mouse CNS nuclei-extraction route, but a separately stated nucleus-specific fixation/permeabilization recipe and its handoff conditions are not provided
cDNA purification delegates B&W buffer to the Dynabeads manufacturer (p00028)

The supplement p00023 calls the second-barcode plate a “first-round barcoding plate”; p00024 calls the next steps round 3 but says material is added to barcodes “in round 2.” The representation follows the explicitly distinct round-2/round-3 plate definitions in p00019 and four-round architecture in primary p00136, labeling the 50+10 μL round-3 assignment as contextual inference
The reported read lengths, UMI-quality/mismatch rejection rules, four-barcode grouping, mapping, UMI collapse and gene-count endpoint are preserved

bounded_source_checks.concern: Unknown cleavage chemistry/released end identity could matter to mechanism-level matching.

targets.action: Immobilize biotinylated DNA on streptavidin beads and magnetically separate it, storing the first supernatant.

Digest the biotinylated DNA on magnetic beads and wash twice, retaining the washes. The source does not identify the digestion enzyme, chemistry or incubation; no cleavage product identity beyond the reported recovered fraction is invented.

Prepare separate Illumina libraries from the recovered DNA using NEBNext Ultra with distinct index primers for each cell. Represent the delegated kit boundary as library end preparation and adapter/index introduction; no Hamilton automation, manufacturer demonstration input amount, size-selection target or PCR count is assigned to DR-seq.

context.quote: The biotinylated DNA was digested on the magnetic beads and the beads were washed twice with 50 μL 1× BW buffer. These two washes were then combined with the first supernatant and purified using a PCR purification column (Qiagen).

bounded_source_checks.finding: The inspected paragraph explicitly supplies digestion, separately retained fractions and combination into recovered DNA for the named library boundary. The workflow preserves these handoffs and declares cleavage/end identity unknown. No general-architecture blocker established by this check; exact mechanism or interchangeable chemistry is not supported.

bounded_source_checks.concern: Borrowing a fragmented-aRNA dependency recipe could silently change the reported unfragmented DR-seq input.

targets.action: Reverse transcribe adapter-ligated aRNA into library cDNA. At the delegated CEL-Seq recipe boundary, take 6 μL of ligated RNA and retain the remainder separately; the exact DR-seq implementation quantities are not restated by the primary paper.

PCR-amplify reverse-transcribed RNA libraries and purify by two AMPure XP cleanups at the delegated CEL-Seq boundary. The retained eluate, not discarded supernatant from bead binding, forms the library.

context.quote: After IVT, the aRNA was immediately cleaned up without fragmentation
3′ Illumina adapters are then ligated to the aRNA followed by reverse transcription and PCR

bounded_source_checks.finding: The primary supplies the unfragmented input and ligation→RT→PCR path; the cited protocol uses fragmented aRNA. The workflow labels adapted quantities/end treatment as dependency prescription, not proven DR-seq execution. No missing general transformation established, but exact end-treatment/compatibility or an executed hybrid recipe must remain unresolved.

bounded_source_checks.concern: Conflicting read-end descriptions and absent ADT collapse details affect exact identity decoding.

targets.action: At the primary paper boundary, extract UMI/A/B from Read 2, trim and map the target read, demultiplex by spatial code and annotate to generate the pixel-by-gene matrix with ST pipeline v1.7.2. The pinned author repository documents a more specific reformatting recipe; that documented rule is retained in resources without asserting identical historical execution or resolving the paper/reference naming discrepancy.

At the primary paper boundary, extract the antibody-derived tag and spatial A/B tags, trim and demultiplex with ST pipeline v1.7.2 to produce a pixel-by-protein matrix. Use the original Table S1 tag-to-marker identities. The proteomics paragraph attributes extraction to Read 2; exact ADT positions and detailed molecule-collapse rule remain unspecified and are not inferred from RNA reformat.pl.

context.quote: we detected spatial barcodes (AiBj, i=1–50, j=1–50) from one end and the corresponding transcripts and protein barcodes from the other end
the Read 2 was processed by extracting the antibody-derived barcode, spatial Barcode A and Barcode B
rows correspond to pixels, defined by (barcode A × barcode B) and columns correspond to proteins.

bounded_source_checks.finding: The tag-to-protein/spatial-matrix purpose and required identity inputs are stated; exact end assignment and counting internals are not resolved. The workflow explicitly preserves the qualified ST-pipeline boundary and source discrepancy. Nonblocking is defensible for that general boundary; it does not license an exact decoder, molecular read-layout equivalence or reproduction of counts.

bounded_source_checks.concern: A missing fixation handoff could erase a required native-material transformation.

targets.action: Homogenize the reported brain/spinal tissue, filter, pellet, wash, filter again, and count nuclei. This is the paper’s adaptation of Krishnaswami et al., not an imported reconstruction of that cited protocol.
Fix isolated nuclei with formaldehyde at the reported assay boundary. Nuclei-specific internal conditions remain unspecified; the cell fixation recipe is not silently assigned to this route.

context.quote: passing a suspension of formaldehyde fixed cells or nuclei through four rounds of combinatorial barcoding

bounded_source_checks.finding: Fixed-nuclei assay input is explicitly supported, and the workflow retains a fixation-boundary operation while marking its extraction-to-fixed-nucleus association as inferred. No omitted required transformation established. Exact nucleus-specific recipe and preparation order are not independently verified; the cell recipe must not be silently transferred.

bounded_source_checks.concern: A read-number contradiction can change which data carry cell/molecule identity.

targets.action: Sequence the purified 3′ library on the NextSeq 500 using the custom primer matching the bead fixed handle. Represent the main sequencing section’s read-1 barcode/UMI read and paired transcript read, while preserving the SeqB note’s unresolved read-number wording.

context.quote: Read 1 was 20 bp (bases 1-12 cell barcode, bases 13-20 UMI); read 2 (paired end)
to prime read 2 for Drop-Seq libraries produced using Barcoded Bead SeqB beads, Read1CustSeqB was used.

bounded_source_checks.finding: The sequencing paragraph defines barcode/UMI and transcript handoffs, while the bead note contains different SeqB read-number wording. The workflow retains both source-specific descriptions and does not claim a resolved executable instrument configuration. General identity architecture remains interpretable; exact SeqB sequencing-port equivalence is not established.

bounded_source_checks.concern: An unassigned replicate-versus-average boundary variable could change numerical initiation estimates.

targets.action: For each 8 min biological sample, divide its intron signal by the averaged 0 min signal plus 1, fit intron signal upstream of the algorithmic boundary as ax+b versus Kb from the TSS, and compute the source approximation I≈bV/B using elongation velocity V and the designated 8 min boundary B. The text does not explicitly specify whether B is replicate-specific or averaged in these separate fits. Exclude modified-Thompson-tau outliers and average retained replicate estimates.

context.quote: If we denote by B the 8 minutes boundary
This calculation was performed separately for all four biological repeats

bounded_source_checks.finding: The source names the 8-min boundary and per-repeat calculation but these inspected statements do not settle the boundary aggregation used in each fit. The workflow keeps the input variable/uncertainty explicit and claims a relative source-described estimator, not numerical reproduction. No general-architecture blocker established; exact repeat-to-boundary association remains consequential for execution.

limits: This audit read every unresolved declaration and inspected packet context only for six concerning candidates; it did not re-audit every workflow clause or search the full web.
Sources here are copied packet text, not reopened raw PDF images, complete dependencies or full archive-custody replay.

Model-declared unresolved is not independently validated source absence, scientific impossibility or a false statement. Six spot checks also do not establish that every missing detail is truly absent from the full paper corpus.
Terminal supported is a model/host gate outcome at declared general scope, not expert acceptance, an executable protocol, complete scientific recall or experimental compatibility.
No repository/frozen records, prompts or runtime were edited. No SSH, remote polling, conversion, model or extraction calls occurred.
